headline: Tencent and Visa are expanding their partnership to explore AI agent payments
body: Tencent and Visa signed a memorandum of understanding to take their partnership beyond cross-border payments. They plan to let travellers pay at participating merchants across the Weixin Pay and Visa networks.
note: The two companies will explore how Visa Intelligent Commerce could help AI agents complete purchases for eligible users, while maintaining consumer control.

evidence.text: Tencent and Visa are expanding their partnership beyond cross-border payments to explore transactions powered by AI agents.
The companies signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to improve payment connectivity for travellers entering and leaving China.
They plan to develop solutions that allow travellers to pay at participating merchants across the Weixin Pay and Visa networks using Tencent’s TenPay Global platform and Visa Pay.
Tencent and Visa will explore how Visa Intelligent Commerce could help AI agents find products, select items and complete purchases for eligible users while maintaining consumer control and security.
